name: docsygen
description: Documentation-driven development workflow: skills for seeding, scaffolding, building, reviewing, and shipping projects in any language (Swift, Android, web, ...). Works in Claude Code and Codex.

interface.longDescription: A language-agnostic set of 31 skills that carry a project from raw idea to shipped release: seed the idea, define the stack and design system, scaffold the structure, build features with full context, review and clean the result, then commit, version, and ship. Docs stay honest along the way.
defaultPrompt: Turn my notes in .docs/idea.md into a seed document
Break this plan into backlog items
